chunks.heading: Every Jetking programme,in one place.
chunks.text: Cloud, cyber security, DevOps and networking — from a four-month foundation course to a three-year degree. Sorted by what suits you; every programme stays listed.

chunks.heading: BCA in Cloud Computing & Cyber Security
chunks.text: Pass in 10+2 from any recognised board (State / CBSE / ICSE / NIOS / IB / IGCSE). Students appearing for 10+2 may also apply. No entrance test.

chunks.heading: MCA in Cloud Computing & Cyber Security
chunks.text: BCA, B.Sc. (Computer Science) or any graduation with Mathematics, minimum 50%. Some intakes require a university / CET entrance.

chunks.heading: BCA in Multimedia & Animation
chunks.text: Pass in 10+2 from a recognised board. Open to students with a creative interest; no prior design experience needed.

chunks.heading: Jetking Certified Cloud Computing Engineer with AI
chunks.text: Any graduate or 10+2 student wanting a career in cloud computing, AI or cyber security.

chunks.heading: Jetking Certified Cloud Computing & Cyber Security Engineer
chunks.text: Any graduate or 10+2 student aiming for a cloud and security support career. Suitable for working professionals entering IT.

chunks.heading: Jetking Certified Cloud Computing Professional with AI
chunks.text: Any graduate or 10+2 student interested in cloud computing, AI or cyber security.

chunks.heading: Jetking Certified Cloud Computing & Cyber Security Professional
chunks.text: Graduates (technical or non-technical) or 10+2 students aspiring to become IT and desktop support professionals.

chunks.heading: Masters in Gaming & Metaverse Design
chunks.text: Open to 10+2 students and graduates with a creative interest in gaming, animation and design.

chunks.heading: Jetking Certified Data Analyst
chunks.text: Open to 10+2 students and graduates interested in a data and analytics career.

chunks.heading: Routing & Switching Administrator (CCNA)
chunks.text: Graduates or 10+2 students; technical graduates need no prior knowledge. Others may start with the Networking Essentials module.

chunks.heading: Microsoft Server Technology Specialist
chunks.text: Any graduate or 10+2 student interested in IT support; basic hardware, networking and Windows knowledge helps.

chunks.heading: Ethical Hacking Specialist
chunks.text: Any graduate or 10+2 student interested in cyber security with hardware, networking and OS knowledge. A bridge course covers missing foundations.

chunks.heading: AWS Solution Specialist
chunks.text: Any graduate or 10+2 student interested in a cloud career, with hardware, networking and server knowledge (bridge course available).

chunks.heading: Red Hat Professional (RHCSA)
chunks.text: Technical graduates, or non-technical graduates and 10+2 candidates with hardware and networking knowledge.

chunks.heading: PC Hardware Support
chunks.text: Open to any graduate, undergraduate or diploma holder. Absolute beginners welcome.

chunks.heading: Windows 10 Operating System
chunks.text: Any graduate or 10+2 student aiming for a desktop support career.

chunks.heading: Networking Essentials Specialist
chunks.text: Basic understanding of computer systems. A relevant background or prior IT exposure helps but is not required.

chunks.heading: Digital Marketing Training Solutions
chunks.text: Open to 10+2 students and graduates interested in a digital marketing career.

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: How do I enquire about a Jetking franchise?

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: Franchise enquiries go through a dedicated team. Submitting the franchise enquiry form starts a conversation about territory availability, the operating model and what partnership involves.

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: What is the profile of a Jetking Franchisee?

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: Jetking franchisees typically include: (1) existing entrepreneurs looking for new opportunities in the education business, (2) professionals with 5–7 years of work experience in any industry, and (3) engineers or MBA graduates with a passion to work in the education business.

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: Who will build my centre? Can I use my existing centre?

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: We will help you build your centre. You can also use your existing setup, provided it matches Jetking’s specifications.

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: What are the responsibilities of a Franchise?

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: As a Jetking franchise, you will be responsible for: (1) investing to set up the training centre as per Jetking specifications, (2) managing and operating the centre daily, (3) following standard operating procedures and conducting training as per Jetking guidelines, (4) creating strong student word-of-mouth by delivering good quality training and good placements, and (5) generating business through multiple marketing activities in your local area.

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: Can I own more than one Franchisee?

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: Yes. Depending upon your performance, you can open another Jetking franchise in any location.

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: Will I be trained to run a Jetking franchise?

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: Yes. We provide training on A–Z of the education business. This includes training for marketing, branding, technology, delivery, recruitment and other support required for day-to-day operations of your learning centre.

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: What kind of technical training will I receive as a franchise?

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: Technical training is provided to your faculty members so they can conduct batches. We also run training programmes to upskill the faculties from time to time.

chunks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
chunks.text: Jetking is ISO 9001:2015 certified and operates through a comprehensive Quality Management Program. Alongside ISO processes, the QMP supports continual improvement in centre operations and delivers customer satisfaction.

chunks.text: Jetking works according to a quality management system and a comprehensive Quality Management Program that supports continual improvement for centre operations. This helps deliver student satisfaction and centre performance.

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: What is the eligibility criteria for the Jetking BCA degree program?

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: Candidates must have completed 10+2 from a recognized board. Mathematics or Computer Science is preferred, but the curriculum builds foundations from scratch, making it accessible to students from various streams.

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: Can I pursue a BCA if I didn't have Mathematics in my 12th grade?

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: Yes. Many specialization tracks include Fundamentals of Mathematics in the early semesters to ensure all students reach the required proficiency.

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: How does Jetking's BCA differ from a traditional BCA?

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: Jetking integrates curriculum mapped with global certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Red Hat), and its SmartLab approach emphasizes 60-70% practical hands-on learning versus purely academic programs.

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: Does Jetking provide placement guarantee for BCA students?

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: No — Jetking does not guarantee placement. It provides comprehensive placement support: resume building, mock interviews with industry experts, and introductions to hiring partners. Outcomes depend on the programme, centre, market and the individual student.

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: What is the duration and format of the course?

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: The BCA is a 3-year, 6-semester full-time degree program, UGC-approved, delivered through offline or hybrid mode.

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: Are there flexible payment options for the course fees?

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: Yes. Jetking offers flexible fee structures including one-time payments and easy installment modes.

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: Yes, cloud computing is an excellent career choice. With the increasing demand for scalable and cost-effective IT solutions, companies across industries are adopting cloud technologies. This has created a high demand for skilled cloud professionals, offering lucrative salaries, diverse job roles (like Cloud Engineer, Architect, and DevOps), and significant growth opportunities. As businesses continue to shift towards digital transformation, cloud computing will remain a vital and rewarding field.

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: Yes, you can learn the basics and advance tools of cloud computing in 6 months with the right focus and dedication with Jetking Vashi institute. Many beginner courses cover essential topics like cloud services (AWS, Azure), storage, networking, and virtualization within this timeframe. However, mastering advanced concepts may take longer depending on your pace and prior IT knowledge.

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: Yes, a fresher can definitely get a job in AI and cloud computing. Many companies value skills and knowledge over experience, especially in these rapidly evolving fields. By taking relevant courses, working on projects, and building a solid understanding of the fundamentals, freshers can enhance their employability. Internships and certifications in AI and cloud technologies can also significantly boost job prospects. Networking and staying updated on industry trends further increase the chances of landing a role in these exciting areas.

chunks.heading: Frequently asked questions
chunks.text: Yes, a non-IT person can definitely pursue a cloud computing course! Many courses are designed for beginners and provide foundational knowledge. With dedication and a willingness to learn, individuals from various backgrounds can successfully transition into cloud computing careers. It's essential to choose a course that offers clear explanations and hands-on practice to build confidence and skills in this field.

faqs.question: How do I enquire about a Jetking franchise?
faqs.answer: Franchise enquiries go through a dedicated team. Submitting the franchise enquiry form starts a conversation about territory availability, the operating model and what partnership involves.

faqs.question: What is the profile of a Jetking Franchisee?
faqs.answer: Jetking franchisees typically include: (1) existing entrepreneurs looking for new opportunities in the education business, (2) professionals with 5–7 years of work experience in any industry, and (3) engineers or MBA graduates with a passion to work in the education business.

faqs.question: Who will build my centre? Can I use my existing centre?
faqs.answer: We will help you build your centre. You can also use your existing setup, provided it matches Jetking’s specifications.

faqs.question: What are the responsibilities of a Franchise?
faqs.answer: As a Jetking franchise, you will be responsible for: (1) investing to set up the training centre as per Jetking specifications, (2) managing and operating the centre daily, (3) following standard operating procedures and conducting training as per Jetking guidelines, (4) creating strong student word-of-mouth by delivering good quality training and good placements, and (5) generating business through multiple marketing activities in your local area.

faqs.question: Can I own more than one Franchisee?
faqs.answer: Yes. Depending upon your performance, you can open another Jetking franchise in any location.

faqs.question: Will I be trained to run a Jetking franchise?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide training on A–Z of the education business. This includes training for marketing, branding, technology, delivery, recruitment and other support required for day-to-day operations of your learning centre.

faqs.question: What kind of technical training will I receive as a franchise?
faqs.answer: Technical training is provided to your faculty members so they can conduct batches. We also run training programmes to upskill the faculties from time to time.

faqs.question: Who enforces quality at Jetking?
faqs.answer: Jetking is ISO 9001:2015 certified and operates through a comprehensive Quality Management Program. Alongside ISO processes, the QMP supports continual improvement in centre operations and delivers customer satisfaction.

faqs.question: How do I start a Jetking Franchise?
faqs.answer: Jetking works according to a quality management system and a comprehensive Quality Management Program that supports continual improvement for centre operations. This helps deliver student satisfaction and centre performance.

faqs.question: What will I learn?
faqs.answer: Deploying secure, robust applications on AWS, covering AWS Services, Management Tools, Databases and Security, and Troubleshooting, focused on the IMS Track across Foundation, Associate, and Architect levels.

faqs.question: Does AWS Solution Architect require coding?
faqs.answer: No, AWS Solution Architect roles typically do not require extensive coding, though familiarity with scripting languages like Python and basic programming concepts can be beneficial for some tasks.

faqs.question: How will this course enhance my career prospects?
faqs.answer: AWS dominates the cloud market, creating high demand. The IMS Track offers roles like Help Desk Support-Cloud Services, Cloud Associate L1, and AWS Cloud NOC Support/Executive L1.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements?
faqs.answer: Any graduate or 10+2 student wanting a cloud career can enroll. Knowledge of hardware, networking and servers is required; others can take Jetking's IoT Bridge Course first.

faqs.question: How to become an AWS solution architect?
faqs.answer: Develop strong understanding of AWS services, obtain certifications, gain hands-on project experience, stay updated with industry trends, network with professionals, and seek mentorship.

faqs.question: What is the cost of AWS certification?
faqs.answer: The cost varies depending on the specific certification exam, with prices typically ranging from Rs.6,000 to Rs.30,000 in Indian rupees.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for the Jetking BCA degree program?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have completed 10+2 from a recognized board. Mathematics or Computer Science is preferred, but the curriculum builds foundations from scratch, making it accessible to students from various streams.
faqs.scope: BCA in Cloud Computing & Cyber Security

faqs.question: Can I pursue a BCA if I didn't have Mathematics in my 12th grade?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many specialization tracks include Fundamentals of Mathematics in the early semesters to ensure all students reach the required proficiency.
faqs.scope: BCA in Cloud Computing & Cyber Security

faqs.question: How does Jetking's BCA differ from a traditional BCA?
faqs.answer: Jetking integrates curriculum mapped with global certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Red Hat), and its SmartLab approach emphasizes 60-70% practical hands-on learning versus purely academic programs.
faqs.scope: BCA in Cloud Computing & Cyber Security

faqs.question: Does Jetking provide placement guarantee for BCA students?
faqs.answer: No — Jetking does not guarantee placement. It provides comprehensive placement support: resume building, mock interviews with industry experts, and introductions to hiring partners. Outcomes depend on the programme, centre, market and the individual student.

faqs.question: Are there flexible payment options for the course fees?

faqs.question: What is a Data Analyst and what does a Data Analyst do?
faqs.answer: A Data Analyst collects, cleans, and analyzes data to help businesses make better decisions using tools like Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python, and Tableau to create reports and dashboards.

faqs.question: What skills are required to become a Data Analyst?
faqs.answer: You need skills in data analysis, statistics, Excel, SQL, Python, data visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau, and the ability to interpret business data.

faqs.question: What will I learn in the Jetking Data Analyst Program?
faqs.answer: The program covers Excel, SQL, Power BI and Tableau for visualization, Python with Pandas and NumPy, and real-world data analytics projects.

faqs.question: Is Data Analytics a good career option?
faqs.answer: Yes, Data Analytics is one of the fastest-growing careers globally, with companies across industries relying on analysts to understand trends and make data-driven decisions.

faqs.question: What Support Services Are Available for Students?
faqs.answer: Jetking provides mentorship programs, career counseling, and access to industry networks to ensure students have the guidance and resources needed to excel.

faqs.question: What job roles can I get after completing a Data Analyst course?
faqs.answer: You can work as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, Data Visualization Specialist, Reporting Analyst, or Junior Data Scientist.

faqs.question: What is the average salary of a Data Analyst?
faqs.answer: Entry-level Data Analysts earn competitive salaries, and with experience and advanced skills professionals grow into higher-paying analytics and data science roles.

faqs.question: What is ethical hacker salary?
faqs.answer: The typical annual salary for an Ethical Hacker in India is around Rs.218,000, with additional cash compensation averaging Rs.168,000, ranging from Rs.24,167 to Rs.435,000 per year.

faqs.question: Is Ethical Hacking legal?
faqs.answer: Yes, Ethical Hacking is legal when conducted with proper authorization. Ethical hackers must obtain permission from the system owner before any security testing or assessment.

faqs.question: Is hands-on experience provided in Ethical Hacking courses?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jetking Ethical Hacking courses include hands-on labs and practical exercises crucial for developing skills to identify and exploit vulnerabilities in real-world scenarios.

faqs.question: Which certifications should I pursue alongside MCA?
faqs.answer: AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Google Associate Cloud Engineer, Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), CompTIA Security+, and CISSP.

faqs.question: What is the average salary in India?
faqs.answer: Freshers earn Rs 4-7 LPA; with 3-5 years experience and certifications, professionals earn Rs 10-25 LPA+.

faqs.question: What is the Microsoft Server MCTS certification?
faqs.answer: MCTS validates your skills in a specific Microsoft technology such as Windows Server, demonstrating your ability to install, configure, and troubleshoot in a Microsoft server environment.

faqs.question: What are the prerequisites for enrolling in the Microsoft Server MCTS course?
faqs.answer: Basic knowledge of computer hardware, networking, and Windows operating systems is recommended. Some experience in IT or a related field can also be beneficial.

faqs.question: Who should take the Microsoft Server MCTS course?
faqs.answer: Ideal for IT professionals, Microsoft system administrators, and anyone seeking to enhance skills in managing Microsoft server environments or pursue advanced certifications.

faqs.question: Why choose Jetking for the Microsoft Server course?
faqs.answer: Immersive learning with interactive material, experienced mentors, skilled evaluators, real-world expert-designed projects, and career services including resume development and interview preparation.

faqs.question: What is essential networking?
faqs.answer: Connecting computers and devices to share resources like internet, files, printers and services, covering IP addressing, DNS, routing, switching and network security for communication and data transfer.

faqs.question: What are the 3 types of networking?
faqs.answer: LAN connects devices within a limited area; WAN covers broad areas linking multiple LANs over long distances; MAN spans a city or large campus between LAN and WAN scale.

faqs.question: What is the importance of this course?
faqs.answer: Computer Hardware and Networking is a fast-growing occupation; this PC Hardware Support course prepares students to maintain desktops in terms of hardware, operating system and applications.

faqs.question: What is a hardware course?
faqs.answer: A program focused on the physical components of computers and electronic devices, how they work, how to assemble and disassemble them, and how to troubleshoot hardware-related issues.

faqs.question: Which computer hardware course is best?
faqs.answer: It depends on your goals, but courses like CompTIA A+, Cisco CCNA, or courses from manufacturers such as Microsoft, Dell or HP are highly regarded.

faqs.question: What is this course about?
faqs.answer: Powered by Red Hat, this course provides all the training required to become a Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) and pass the EX200 exam.

faqs.question: What will I learn in Red Hat course (RHCSA)?
faqs.answer: You will learn Red Hat System Administration I (RH124) and II (RH134), starting with fundamentals of shell commands, creating and modifying users, changing passwords and more.

faqs.question: How will this Linux certified course enhance my career prospects?
faqs.answer: It opens many job opportunities for a Linux systems administrator in reputed companies, with higher positions and strong career growth as you gain experience.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for RHCSA?
faqs.answer: Technical graduates, or non-technical graduates / 10+2 candidates with Hardware & Networking knowledge.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of obtaining (RHCSA) Red Hat certification?
faqs.answer: It validates your skills as a Linux system administrator, enhances career prospects, and opens employment opportunities in organizations that rely on Red Hat technologies.

faqs.question: Who is the Red Hat Linux course suitable for?
faqs.answer: Individuals interested in becoming proficient Linux system administrators, whether beginners or experienced professionals seeking formal recognition of their skills.

faqs.question: What is CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate)?
faqs.answer: CCNA is a globally recognized IT certification from Cisco for those new to networking, validating skills to understand, configure, operate and troubleshoot medium-level switched and routed networks.

faqs.question: What is routing and switching?
faqs.answer: Routing directs data packets between networks based on destination IP addresses; switching forwards packets within a single network based on device MAC addresses for efficient communication.

faqs.question: What is the role of a routing and switching job?
faqs.answer: Configuring, managing, and troubleshooting network routers and switches, designing topologies, optimizing performance, implementing security, and resolving connectivity issues.

faqs.question: How will this course enhance career prospects?
faqs.answer: Prepares graduates to install, configure, operate, maintain and troubleshoot LAN, WAN and other networks, earning Jetking Certification and qualifying for L1-level networking positions.

faqs.question: What is the course overview?
faqs.answer: Technology Specialists configure, implement, troubleshoot and debug a technology; this course skills you in these aspects and prepares you for the global Windows 10 certification (70-697).

faqs.question: What is the name of Windows certification?
faqs.answer: Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA), Microsoft Solutions Developer (MCSD), and Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE).

faqs.question: How much does Windows 10 certification cost?
faqs.answer: Typically ranges from Rs 15,000 to Rs 30,000 for exams and training materials, plus possible extras such as study guides, practice exams and training courses.
